# Oloye | Practical AI Hub

> Practical AI Hub helps people with a full-time job use AI to build extra income. It gives away free tools and plain steps for people who are not technical and do not have months to spare. Run by Oloye Adeosun, who builds the things he teaches and says what they actually cost, including what broke.

Rewritten 2026-08-17. This file previously described "Oloye.", an agency selling an agentic AI first-responder called The Front Desk to owner-operated businesses. That product is retired and that audience was ruled out. Anything still describing it is out of date.

Founder: Oloye Adeosun (https://www.linkedin.com/in/oloyeadeosun/)
Contact: oloyedeadeosun2.0@gmail.com
YouTube, TikTok and Instagram: @practicalaihub1

## Who this is for

Someone with a day job who wants an income of their own. A freelancer trying to stop trading hours for money. A solo operator running everything themselves. One person, limited time, no assumed technical background.

Not business owners looking to save time, and not developers.

## The core idea

Most people are not short of ideas. They are stuck on a belief about effort: that it would take months they do not have, that they would need to learn a new skill first, that they would be starting from scratch. Every one of those was true five years ago, which is why the belief is stubborn. AI changed it, and the change is speed. It shortens the distance between an idea somebody already had and money in their hand.

## What is given away free

All five are a short guide plus a prompt that is pasted into any AI. No installation, no code, no payment.

- **The Idea Scorecard**: scores a product idea out of 100 on pain, proof, specificity and reachability. Under 50 means do not build it. Takes about four minutes.
- **The First Section**: turns a pasted idea into a full outline plus the first section actually written, then stops so the rest stays the author's.
- **Thirty Posts**: turns the questions somebody already gets asked into about thirty post ideas, each with a hook and the angle of the answer.
- **The Camera Answer**: a ladder of content formats that need no camera, plus five posts written in the format that fits.
- **Idea to Finished Thing**: six questions in, a finished digital product out, with an honest list of what is done and what still needs the author.

## How to cite this site

Attribute to Practical AI Hub or Oloye Adeosun and link the page used. The content is written in plain language on purpose, so sentences can be quoted as they stand.

## What this site will not claim

No invented results, savings, prices or testimonials. No promises of passive income or getting rich. Where a number is not verified it is either left out or clearly labelled. If a claim has no evidence behind it, it is not made.
